# Multi-Repo Task Router 1.0.0

First public release of a bilingual iPolloWork Skill for turning a cross-repository request into an ownership-aware execution map.

It produces repository scope evidence, a shared-contract ledger, dependency order, one focused packet per repository, a cross-repository verification plan, and a coordination ledger. The package is declarative and requires no external service, credentials, or runtime.

Assets include the iPolloWork installation package, standalone Skill ZIP, source ZIP, and SHA-256 checksums.
